{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### AI Coding Agent Audit

`jt-ai-agent` · rules 133700-133799

An audit trail of what AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI, Cursor and GitHub Copilot) do on a host: every shell command, file change, web fetch, MCP call, subagent and session, recorded by a hook (managed hooks or system settings for each agent; opencode: a plugin) before it runs (Cursor: right after), with secrets in command lines replaced by ***. Graded rules for destructive commands (locally and over SSH), reading private keys and credential files, download-and-run, an agent changing its own permissions and hooks, sessions with all permission prompts off, and tampering with the audit itself. An inventory script finds AI coding agents on hosts the audit does not cover and local model servers (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) listening on the network.

Discover query:

`rule.id:[133700 TO 133799] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-ai-agent · About","type":"markdown"}
